source_artifacts.claim: The Great Cell Shuffle combines motor-stop/Pac island gate, Pac-held bridge/Isp gate, Isp rescue latch for all gates/support, two slime gaps and a short STOP bubble lane.
Gem is planted at the STOP shore and targets the DNA bridge; Cana owns Pac finish gate, countered by rescue.
Current roster order places these rooms at positions 5-8, after hold/rescue, powered lift, bridge relay and ferry brake introductions.
Accepted hero/ANY-crate occupancy activates hold pads; latch activation persists. Active pads open gates, stop motors, supply power or stabilize bridges.
Unstabilized occupied bridges collapse and respawn; moving platforms only move when active, motor-on and powered; unpowered platforms remain solid.
Slime overlap or falling beyond bounds kills; completion requires both matching exits, not collectibles.
Retry reconstructs the complete initial room state, so latched progress is not a death checkpoint.
Bubble causes Isp FLOAT/Pac side STICKY; boomerang causes Isp DIZZY/Pac SHOVE; effects expire.
Each newly active bound pad clears current projectiles once and restarts cooldown; a latched rescue does not permanently disable attacks.
Players jump, collide and may push or stand on their partner; FLOAT suppresses jumping, STICKY disables voluntary movement, DIZZY slows and SHOVE adds horizontal velocity.
Separate ordinary keyboard mappings are A/D/W and arrows; mappings alone do not measure shared-keyboard comfort.

common_mistakes.mistake: Pac attempts the island landing after Isp was floated off STOP, or Isp abandons STOP before Pac is across.
common_mistakes.consequence: Pac island gate closes and ferry movement resumes. Pac can be blocked safely if still supported, but an off-edge jump can fall into slime.
common_mistakes.recovery: Wait on the ferry while Isp lands/reoccupies STOP, as the bounded replay demonstrates. A lethal fall resets the entire room; it does not resume on the island.

confidence_reason: Source mechanics and accepted ordinary-input completion are supported, with actual unassisted PNG cues inspected. Scores remain expert estimates: novice discovery, paired comfort, enjoyment and distributions of mistakes are unmeasured. Source-derived recovery is not a witnessed human recovery.

confirmed: The source confirms the first-pass ferry -> Pac STEADY -> Isp RESCUE hypothesis, two distinct sequential support roles and real pit danger. The retained/current route completes with that causal order.
missed_mechanics: STOP simultaneously brakes the ferry and opens Pac island gate; bubble FLOAT can remove Isp from the pad. Pac can wait on the ferry, and the local replay records safe reoccupancy. Rescue permanently retains gates/bridge for the current attempt but only briefly interrupts an attack.
incorrect_inferences: No definite false mechanic was asserted in the conditional first pass. Movement/waits are not counted as extra reasoning, and no additional timing score is assigned merely because the route includes two gaps.
changed_judgments: Recovery null -> 2: source identifies room-wide retry after slime death, while the retained ordinary-input sequence demonstrates that nonlethal brake loss can be recovered by waiting/reoccupying without reset. All other numeric estimates are retained with source-backed role and physical consequences.

The bubble introduction is attributed to actual first campaign level_02; ferry and bridge introductions remain level_03 and level_04 in their current campaign positions, irrespective of stable numeric ID order.
unresolved: No novice discovery, enjoyment, success-rate or physical two-person keyboard-comfort study exists.

Human discovery of the combined role order, mistimed-jump frequency and paired keyboard comfort are unmeasured. No full alternative bypass route is established; ordinary-input clear evidence is not evidence of novice ease. Controls remain null.

single_operator_note: A single operator must alternate both movement/jump groups while keeping the supporting hero in place and recognize role handoffs; the two-human baseline does not include that extra attention/input-management demand.
